headline: Portfolio Outperforms SPY YTD
summary: As of July 6, 2026, the portfolio is showing an average return of 16.02%, significantly outperforming the SPY benchmark return of 10.87%. This results in an average alpha of 5.15%, indicating that the portfolio is not only gaining in absolute terms but also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has achieved a remarkable return of 46.11%, contributing positively to the overall performance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Google 100', has returned 7.44%, which is still above the benchmark but less impactful. This outperformance relative to SPY is particularly noteworthy during periods of market uncertainty, reinforcing the portfolio's strength in challenging conditions. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
